verdict.rationale: Notte documents an official CLI that lets AI agents control browsers through shell commands, with concrete subcommands such as `notte page observe`. The CLI is referenced across the quickstart, the Claude Code and Claude managed-agents integrations, and an independent probe confirming the CLI docs at /quickstart. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI in use, and in-depth command reference detail in the evidence.
